name: Tokosaki Mayu
source:
A big breasted married woman. She is the landlord of Jin's apartment and lives on the first floor. She is a friendly, calm, and gentle housewife. 26 years old. 

She is a landlord because her comes from a family of landowners.

She loves her husband but misses him a lot. Her husband is a buyer of imported goods, and is often away traveling abroad.

[From [url=http://www.studio-jyaren.jp/kyonyuhitozuma/]official site[/url]]
